Average and over priced
Jun 2017 • Couples
Visited this little Thai place desperate for some Thai food which we eat at least twice a week back home, most of which I cook. The food was okay, but not up to the standard we are used to back home in England (not to flatter me - there are some fine Thai restaurants in Sheffield), and nowhere near the quality of the food I ate in Thailand. To break it down the mango salad was superb, but the soups had none of the subtlety of a good Thai chef and were a bit disappointing, as if they had been thrown together. 60,000 dong for a small Singha was expensive and for Vietnam the total bill was very expensive although this is in a high end area. Get your Thai fix elsewhere I suggest.

After six days time to have a change
Oct 2016 • Couples
After six days of Vietnamese food it was time for a change.
We found Malee Thai a few streets away from hotel, and proved to be a very good change.
Staff very friendly and very clean and bright restaurant done in traditional Thai style.
My wife had her favourite Lad Na Gai and I had one of my second favourite being Kang Massman Gai (chicken curry). While not as good as I would have in my favourite restaurant in Thailand, was still very good.
I would recommend this restaurant to any one who wanted to try Thai food while in Saigon.
The meals well priced and large enough serving ours cost around $30 Australian or 520,000 Dong, that included two soft drinks and steamed rice.
